content.raw:
Obstetrics and gynaecology covers women's health at every stage of life, from fertility and pregnancy to menopause and gynaecological oncology. MedLuxLife arranges consultations, diagnostics and treatment with specialists at our partner hospital, who work together with radiology, psychiatry and other departments when needed. We take care of scheduling, translation and travel so you can concentrate on your health.

Treatments and services

Infertility clinic

Evaluation of couples who have difficulty conceiving, with treatment planned at the appropriate time.

IVF centre

Standard IVF plus microinjection, TESA, TESE, co-culture, in vitro maturation, assisted hatching and preimplantation genetic diagnosis, with research activities including stem cell research.

Recurrent losses and IVF failure

Investigation of recurrent pregnancy loss and repeated unsuccessful IVF attempts.

Menopause clinic

Support during menopause, including mammography, bone density measurement and psychological counselling in cooperation with radiology and psychiatry.

Perinatology

Care for pregnancy from preconception through birth and the postpartum period, including higher-risk pregnancies.

Prenatal screening and imaging

Screening for chromosomal and structural anomalies, 3D ultrasound and invasive perinatal procedures where indicated.

Gynaecological oncology

Counselling, screening, differential diagnosis and medical and surgical treatment of gynaecological tumours.

Familial cancer and prevention

Diagnosis of hereditary cancer risk with preventive and therapeutic approaches, including protective and therapeutic vaccination.

Services in detail

  • Antenatal consultation
  • Genetic counselling for families with a history of hereditary disease
  • Preparation for pregnancy
  • Pregnancy monitoring
  • Prenatal education
  • Birth
  • Postpartum counselling
  • Recurrent miscarriages
  • Counselling after a difficult obstetric history
  • Chromosomal and structural anomaly screening
  • 3D ultrasound
  • Invasive perinatal interventions
  • Oncological counselling
  • Screening programmes
  • Consultation and differential diagnosis of suspected gynaecological cases
  • Medical and surgical treatment of gynaecological cancers
  • Treatment of pre-invasive, borderline and invasive tumours of the reproductive system
  • Protective and therapeutic vaccinations in gynaecological oncology
  • Diagnosis of familial cancers with preventive and therapeutic approaches
  • Diagnosis and treatment of pre-invasive lesions of the cervix

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Previous ultrasound, smear or hormone test results
  • Pregnancy records or earlier IVF treatment summaries, if applicable

How MedLuxLife supports you

1. Free consultation

Share your wishes and, if available, recent X-rays or photos. We answer your questions and explain the options.

2. Personal treatment plan

Our partner specialists prepare a treatment plan and an estimated timeline tailored to you.

3. Travel & treatment

We coordinate your appointments, hotel and airport transfers, so you can focus on your treatment.

4. Aftercare

We stay in touch after you return home and help with follow-up questions.

Plan your Obstetrics and Gynaecology consultation with confidence

Every treatment begins with a personal, no-obligation consultation. Contact us and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

Request a Free Consultation
WhatsApp

The information on this page is for general guidance only and does not replace a medical consultation. Suitability for any treatment is assessed individually by a qualified doctor.
